INSERT INTO notification_subscription (id, user_id, endpoint, expiration_time, p256dh, auth)
            SELECT
                $1,
                u.id,
                $2,
                $3,
                $4,
                $5
            FROM users u
            WHERE u.username = $6
            ON CONFLICT (user_id)
            DO UPDATE SET
                endpoint = EXCLUDED.endpoint,
                p256dh = EXCLUDED.p256dh,
                auth = EXCLUDED.auth,
                expiration_time = EXCLUDED.expiration_time;
